title: Aircall Pricing in 2026: Essentials, Professional and Add-Ons
summary: Aircall Essentials is $30 and Professional $50 per license a month billed annually, or $40 and $70 monthly, with a 3-license minimum. See add-ons and terms.
body_markdown:
Aircall publishes prices for two of its three plans. Essentials is $30 per license a month billed annually, or $40 billed monthly. Professional is $50 billed annually, or $70 billed monthly. Both need at least three licenses. Enterprise is custom and starts at 25 licenses. The Power Dialer is on Professional and Enterprise, not Essentials. The pages were read on November 17, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. Every Aircall detail below comes from Aircall's own pricing page and help centre, opened on November 17, 2026. No price here comes from a review site. No Aircall account was used and nothing was tested. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. Aircall](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-aircall) .


## Aircall pricing at a glance


Aircall's[pricing page](https://aircall.io/pricing/) shows US prices with a switch between annual and monthly billing. It says annual billing saves 25%.

The trial terms come from Aircall's[trial article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/15149698584733) . It describes a 7-day free trial with Essentials and Professional features. Calls are capped at 100 minutes in total and 7 minutes each, with up to three numbers and 100 message segments. Number porting is not available. The trial ends on its own. The pricing page calls this free access, and its FAQ says new accounts also get 100 AI Voice Agent minutes.


The help centre also describes a[Starter AI Plan](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/36572078998941) built around AI Voice Agents, with one user, one number and no three-user minimum. That article states no price.


## What changes the real cost of Aircall


The license price is public. The bill also depends on the seat minimum, the term, numbers, add-ons and usage.


### The three-license minimum


The pricing page says Essentials and Professional need at least three licenses on either billing cycle. So the smallest Essentials bill is $90 a month on annual billing, or $120 on monthly billing. The smallest Professional bill is $150 a month on annual billing, or $210 on monthly billing.


Aircall's[license removal article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/38958722678557) says an account must always keep at least three user licenses. Its[billing article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/21703001898013) says every user needs a license, including admins who make no calls.


### Annual or monthly billing


Aircall's[plans article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/30599733509277) lists four subscription types: monthly, annual with monthly invoices, annual paid upfront, and annual upfront with extra licenses billed monthly. Monthly has no long-term commitment and the highest price. Annual upfront gives up to 25% off, and the licenses are locked for the year.


The same article says there is no pro-rated refund or credit when an extra user is removed mid-cycle.


### Numbers and calling


Each plan includes one local or toll-free number. Each additional number is $6 a month. Inbound and internal calls are unlimited, with toll-free excluded. Outbound calls within the US and Canada are unlimited under Aircall's Terms of Use.


International calling is not priced on the page. Essentials and Professional say to contact Aircall for rates and bundles. Enterprise lists unlimited global calls. For texting, the table says to contact Aircall for rates, and a footnote lists 4,000 outbound messages per user a month.


### Add-ons


- **AI Assist Pro:** $49 per seat a month, for live coaching during calls. Post-call AI summaries are included in Professional.
- **WhatsApp in Aircall:** $10 per seat a month.
- **Analytics+:** $15 per seat a month.
- **Aircall for Salesforce Voice:** $30 per seat a month.
- **Number Reputation Dashboard:** $0.03 per reputation check.
- **Branded caller ID:** $0.08 per call for each brand.
- **AI Messaging Agents:** $0.15 to $0.35 per conversation.


Aircall's[subscription article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/19549366516253) says add-ons are billed on the number of standard users in the plan, even if not all licenses are in use.


### AI Voice Agent minutes


Essentials and Professional include 50 AI Voice Agent minutes a month. More minutes cost $0.29 a minute pay as you go. Bundles are $250 a month for 1,000 minutes, $805 for 3,500 and $1,900 for 10,000. Bundles are billed monthly with an annual commitment.


### Taxes and fees


The pricing page's FAQ says there are no administrative recovery fees or hidden surcharges. Aircall's help centre article on[US and Canada taxes and fees](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/10375354920349) describes a Compliance and Administrative Cost Recovery Fee and an E911 Regulatory Recovery Fee, each billed per user. The amounts are not published, so ask for an itemised quote.


### Renewal and cancellation


Aircall's[renewal article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/29591494465309) says a plan renews automatically under the same terms. Its[cancellation article](https://support.aircall.io/en-gb/articles/19179941054877) says the standard terms require 30 days' written notice before the renewal date. Accounts with 1 to 10 seats can cancel in the dashboard without that notice, unless they have a commitment or an annual plan.


Accounts with more than 10 seats must email Customer Success at least 30 days before renewal, or the contract renews. On a month-to-month plan, a removed license stays on the bill until the next renewal date.


## Who Aircall fits and who it does not


Aircall describes itself as a customer communication platform. Every plan lists a business phone system with IVR, call routing, a shared inbox, texting and more than 250 integrations. That fits a team that wants one tool for incoming calls, texts and outbound calls.


It also fits a team of three or more that wants one-line power dialing at a public price. Professional, at $50 a license on annual billing, includes the Power Dialer, voicemail drop and outbound campaigns.


Aircall is a weaker fit for one or two users, because Essentials and Professional start at three licenses. It is also a weaker fit for a team that picks Essentials for the price and then needs to dial lists, since the Power Dialer starts at Professional.


The pricing page describes one dialer for reps, the Power Dialer, which dials an imported list of up to 1,000 numbers in sequence. A team that wants to call several numbers at once for each rep should ask Aircall what it offers.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does Aircall cost per user?


Aircall's pricing page lists Essentials at $30 per license a month billed annually, or $40 billed monthly. Professional is $50 billed annually, or $70 billed monthly. Both need at least three licenses. Enterprise is custom pricing from 25 licenses. Each additional phone number is $6 a month.


### What is the minimum number of Aircall licenses?


Three on Essentials and Professional, on annual and monthly billing alike. That makes the smallest Essentials bill $90 a month on annual billing or $120 on monthly billing. Enterprise starts at 25 licenses.


### Does Aircall have a free trial?


Yes. Aircall's help centre describes a 7-day free trial with Essentials and Professional features. Calls are capped at 100 minutes in total and 7 minutes each. It ends on its own, so there is nothing to cancel.


### Which Aircall plan includes the Power Dialer?


Professional and Enterprise. The pricing page says the Power Dialer imports up to 1,000 numbers and dials them in sequence, on desktop and web. Essentials does not include it. Voicemail drop and outbound campaigns also start at Professional.


### What costs extra on Aircall?


Extra numbers are $6 a month each. AI Assist Pro is $49 per seat a month, WhatsApp $10, Analytics+ $15 and Aircall for Salesforce Voice $30. AI Voice Agent minutes beyond the 50 included are $0.29 each or sold in bundles. International calling rates are quoted, not published.
